title: Filipino-Style Battered Lumpia with Anchovy Dipping Sauce
description: A crispy and flavorful Filipino-inspired dish made with lumpia and served with a tangy anchovy dipping sauce.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together vinegar, salt, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, mix together chopped anchovies and water.
Dip each lumpia wrapper into the vinegar mixture, coating both sides.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Fry the lumpia until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain the lumpia on paper towels.
Serve the lumpia with the anchovy dipping sauce.
To make the dipping sauce, mix together the anchovy mixture and vinegar mixture.
